WATER / 02

SHALLOW SOIL MOISTURE—

Model estimate for 0–1 cm. It does not describe groundwater or irrigation supply.

READING WATER DATA

Rain is not the same as water available to your crop.

Rainfall forecasts describe expected precipitation. Reference ET₀ describes atmospheric evaporative demand. Shallow soil moisture describes a modeled near-surface layer. None alone measures reservoir storage, groundwater, irrigation access, or the water held throughout a field’s root zone.

Before choosing: confirm region-appropriate varieties, planting windows, crop prices, machinery, pest history, soil tests, water access, and extension recommendations.
LEGUME

Soybean

Can contribute biologically fixed nitrogen, depending on nodulation, harvest removal, and management. Water needs vary by climate and growth stage.

WARM SEASON GRAIN

Sorghum

Often selected for heat tolerance; local cultivar, planting timing, and water conditions determine suitability.

COVER OPTION

Cover crops

Can protect soil between cash crops. Species selection affects water use, termination timing, and following-crop establishment.
